fusions.name: Skittish Swat
fusions.desc: A swat that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rearing Buck
fusions.desc: Rears and bucks, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Startled Bolt
fusions.desc: Bolts 2 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flinch Reflex
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
